parts.name: Screen Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the screen side of a laptop, typically made of aluminum alloy for durability and heat dissipation.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the display panel and webcam, providing the visual interface for the user.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the hinge to open or close the laptop.

parts.name: Base Side
parts.Basic_description: This is the base side of the laptop, made of aluminum alloy, containing the keyboard, touchpad, and internal components.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the main input devices and houses the motherboard, battery, and other electronics.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the screen side moves; it serves as the main support structure.

parts.name: Connector
parts.Basic_description: This is the hinge connector of the laptop, made of stainless steel for strength and durability.
parts.Functional_description: It connects the screen side and base side, allowing smooth rotation and maintaining structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It enables rotational movement between the screen and base, typically up to 135–180 degrees.
